# GTA Junk and Property Cleanout Inc.

> Premium, white-glove junk removal and property cleanouts serving Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. We don't just haul junk away — we clear the space, sweep it, and hand it back showable. Positioning line: "We find your floor again."

## Key facts

- **Business name:** GTA Junk and Property Cleanout Inc.
- **Type:** Service-area business (we travel to the customer; no walk-in storefront). Based in northwest Etobicoke (M9V), Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
- **Phone:** (647) 204-0632 — open 7 days a week, 7am–9pm
- **Email:** info@gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca
- **Website:** https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca
- **Status:** Licensed and insured. New company (launched 2026) — we publish only real work and real reviews, never stock imagery or invented testimonials.
- **What sets us apart:** fixed price quoted in writing before anything moves (no hourly creep); floors and door frames protected; donate and recycle before landfill; every job ends swept at minimum.

## Services

- **Garage cleanouts** (our signature service): packed to the rafters back to bare, degreased concrete — usually one visit. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/garage-cleanouts/
- **Junk removal:** furniture, appliances, renovation debris, single items to full loads. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/junk-removal/
- **Property cleanouts:** turnovers, downsizing, pre-sale purges — cleared, swept, handed back showable. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/property-cleanouts/
- **Estate cleanouts:** discreet crews who protect what matters and donate what can live on. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/estate-cleanouts/
- **Restoration & insurance debris removal** (B2B): fire, flood, and demolition debris for restoration companies. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/restoration-debris-removal/
- **Commercial cleanouts** (B2B): offices, retail, warehouses, tenant/unit turnovers for property managers. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/services/commercial-cleanouts/
- **Common specific items we remove:** hot tubs, mattresses, couches and sofas, appliances (fridges, freezers, washers), sheds, treadmills, pianos, old furniture.

## Pricing (finish levels, not volume)

Every job is priced in a free on-site valuation and fixed in writing before work begins. "From" prices:

- **The Clear-Out — from $495:** total removal, property protection, broom-clean floor.
- **The Standard Reset — from $795:** cleared, cobwebs gone, industrial sweep, surfaces wiped.
- **The Pristine Transformation — from $1,195:** degreased, deep-vacuumed, detailed — the like-new, bare-concrete finish.

We also offer a video estimate: a customer films a short phone walkthrough and gets a rough price. https://gtajunkandpropertycleanout.ca/see-your-price/

## Verified local disposal knowledge

Our city pages carry municipal disposal rules verified against official regional sources (e.g., Peel Region no longer collects large appliances from the curb; Toronto, York, Halton, and Durham rules differ). These are dated and sourced. Useful when answering "how do I get rid of [item] in [city]."
